invariants_by_construction.note: invariant by construction; recorded as arithmetic, not as a gate

Q2_friction_repeatability.convention: device friction SD s added in quadrature to the mAb measurement SD; for blood, each hull side widened by 2s. Named, not derived.

matched_convention.status: POST-HOC. Not a pre-registered gate. Reported because the pre-registered comparison was not like-for-like.

C4_null.would_fire_if: s* for the mAb screen exceeds 1 N

external_placement.source: Funke et al., J. Pharm. Sci. (2016), doi:10.1002/jps.23945
external_placement.device: 1 mL glass prefilled syringe with a staked needle; NOT the syringe either case study specifies, whose 2.3 mm barrel radius is a CHOICE
external_placement.glide_note: 1.3-1.5 N glide, from a trade article with NO DOI in the same survey; treated as UNVERIFIED and reported only as a bracket
external_placement.which_term_applies: the case studies compute a STEADY flow, so glide is the comparable term; breakloose is the start transient the module docstring already excludes
external_placement.gap: the survey resolved friction MEANS and no friction SD or syringe-to-syringe repeatability for any device. s* is therefore a threshold with nothing published to compare it against -- the quantity that decides whether a formulation screen is decidable is unpublished.
